# The sale price isn't your payout. Net profit is.

> Free calculator for StockX sneaker, streetwear, and card sellers: find real net payout and net profit after the seller fee (which drops by seller level), the Fast Shipping discount, the payment processing fee, and outbound shipping cost, then check a month of sales against a profit goal.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
